title: Model reduction of port-Hamiltonian systems via neural networks
summary: In this paper, we consider structure-preserving model reduction of port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems which extend classical Hamiltonian systems with dissipation and an input-output port. These pH systems are often used in multi-physics systems, as the interconnection of one or more \pH systems results again in a pH system.
